title: CustomerGoal holdout case (Inquiry v3.5 §25.13)
description: One frozen holdout case. The gold is written in the v3 three-token space; a v2 comparison arm is read into it by folding INFORMATION and DECISION to ANSWER, never the other way. Instances live only in the durable eval store.

q.description: case id. H:<8 hex> is a real inquiry; H:Snn is synthetic.

text.description: the customer's message. Never committed to the repository.

s.description: C ambiguous ANSWER · A plain ANSWER · T true ACTION · S STATE_READ · N no goal · R relation or single inference

conf.description: HIGH: a careful reader lands here without argument. Only HIGH enters the primary metric.

goals.description: the gold goals, in the order the message states them. Empty means the message requests nothing.

prefixItems.description: expected explicit_constraints COUNT, as in the frozen gold

relation.description: a customer-stated fallback: [primary index, fallback index, the clause that states it]. The clause must appear in `text`; build.py refuses it otherwise.

pair.description: a minimal pair name. Every pair must appear on BOTH sides of the gold, so the ambiguity marker cannot predict the label.

why.description: why this label and not the nearest other one. Written before the run.
